What happened to the Indians from 1967 who talked about the future in that viral video (thanks to ) by the Film Division of India? What were their names? Where are they now? TN Subramaniam, Aditya Kashyap, Nayana Puranik, Ashutosh Haldipur, Shailesh Gandhi, Victor Menezes and Dunu Roy - such interesting characters who you loved and admired - let us know their backstories!
